movie.title: Muito Prazer
movie.overview: Rubem, a rideshare driver with no prospects, receives as inheritance the Pérola Motel, which he soon discovers is a dilapidated building. There, he meets Grace, a former employee who had stayed on living in one of the suites after the motel closed. Unable to sell the property and mired in debt, Grace and Rubem join forces to reopen the motel. Almost as a lark and with the help of Nalva, an internet whiz, they begin recording their guests and, to make some extra cash, selling the videos with identities masked to erotic websites. The scheme quickly becomes both lucrative and dangerous.

aiEnrichment.summary_short: After inheriting the run-down Pérola Motel, desperate rideshare driver Rubem joins forces with Grace, a remaining resident employee, to reopen the business and clear their mounting debts. With the help of an internet-savvy ally named Nalva, they start secretly recording their guests' intimate encounters and selling identity-masked videos to erotic websites. aiEnrichment.summary_long: Rubem is a struggling rideshare driver burdened by debt and lacking any clear prospects for his future. His life takes an unexpected turn when he inherits the Pérola Motel, only to discover it is a crumbling, shut-down property on the brink of ruin. Upon inspecting the site, he encounters Grace, a resilient former employee who has been squatting in one of the vacant suites since the business closed. Facing severe financial pressure and an impossible real estate market, the duo decides to combine forces to get the motel operational again. Desperate for capital, they recruit Nalva, a tech-savvy internet whiz, to help them execute a risky monetization scheme. Together, they install hidden cameras in the rooms to record their guests, meticulously masking their identities before selling the footage to adult websites. The plan works surprisingly well, generating a massive influx of income that quickly solves their immediate financial woes. However, as the secret operation grows larger and more lucrative, the ethical boundaries blur and the danger of exposure intensifies. Rubem and Grace are forced to manage both their evolving personal dynamic and the volatile risks of their illicit online empire.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Muito Prazer is a comedy-drama that explores themes of financial desperation, unexpected partnership, and modern privacy boundaries through the lens of a unconventional business venture. When Rubem, an impoverished rideshare driver, inherits the derelict Pérola Motel, he finds an unexpected ally in Grace, a former staff member living out of the abandoned suites. Unable to liquidate the debt-ridden asset, the pair reopens the doors and turns to an illicit secret camera operation aided by tech specialist Nalva. As their undercover adult-content venture takes off, the story balances humor, romance, and rising tension while the trio navigates the high-stakes moral and legal complications of their newfound success.
